propositions: Build an operator-run provider-parity harness modeled on fidelity_spot_eval precedent to measure Bedrock against direct Anthropic using the same parity bar (structured-output validity, decision-level flip agreement, recall/false-accept margins, runtime error rate, gold-coverage floor).

Probe both candidate Bedrock inference-profile ids for invokability in account 896586841071/us-east-1 with bare calls and temperature=0, before corpus spend, and record refusals if either slot is unmeasurable.

Pool gold-labelled cases across 15 eval specs (30 items: 15 block + 15 advisory) to clear MIN_GOLD_ITEMS=20 floor; exclude agentic disposable-store arms (completion-verifier, ticket-quality, spec-alignment) so provider is the only variable between arms.
Run paired arms at N=3 epochs per case under gate_config wrapping to ensure only the model differs, with per-call model tallied from REBAR_USAGE_LOG to prove zero non-Bedrock calls on the v2 arm.

Prove payload parity (same system prompt, messages, tools, max_tokens, temperature reaching both providers via captured requests) and tool parity (identical names, descriptions, input schemas) rather than comparing LLM judgement equivalence.

Record committed measured results in provider_parity_results.json with either a measured ParityReport block or an unmeasured block with exact refusal string, and gate S8 cutover on confirmation of payload/tool parity and provider-clean routing rather than decision-agreement metrics.
